name: reyhanitsme/auth-engine
description: Plug-and-play, framework-agnostic PHP authentication engine (Native PHP & Laravel): credentials, magic links, OTP/TOTP, passkeys, OAuth and a modern UI scaffolder.

suggest.ext-curl: Faster HTTP client for OAuth (falls back to PHP streams).
suggest.ext-sodium: Recommended for Argon2id hashing and signed tokens.
suggest.illuminate/support: Required only when the package is used inside Laravel (^10.0|^11.0|^12.0).

scripts.lint: find src tests config bin scripts stubs/vanilla -type f \( -name '*.php' -o -name 'easy-auth' \) -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 php -l
